questions.stemHtml: A 45-year-old car mechanic presented to the emergency department with sudden onset right arm pain and swelling. During his routine work of hammering, he heard a ‘pop’ sound and his right arm gave away. On examination, the following finding was seen. The clinician made the diagnosis of a bicipital tendon tear. Which of the following is the site of attachment of the biceps tendon?
